result.prompt: Create a 10-second naturalistic text-to-video meditation-app background of ocean waves at sunset, vertical 9:16, with ambient audio on. Use photoreal live-action imagery, warm peach-gold sunset light, a peaceful mood, fine wet-sand texture, and gentle, unhurried wave energy. One continuous shot with the same empty beach, low horizon, sunset lighting, and locked-off camera throughout; this is a standalone calming background, not a narrative scene. From 0–5s, frame a wide shoreline view from low on the beach: a shallow ocean wave, anchored by its thin white foam edge across the lower third, slowly advances over smooth wet sand; the distant horizon is a fine horizontal line in the upper third beneath a softly glowing sky, and the camera remains completely stationary. From 5–10s, maintain the identical wide framing: the wave, anchored by that same foam edge, gently recedes, revealing a warm reflection on the foreground sand; the camera remains locked off. During the final two seconds, hold the still, uncluttered composition without reframing or introducing anything new, allowing only the water's quiet natural movement. Sound is exclusively soft, synchronized ocean wash and foam retreat, at an even, soothing level. Finish with a restrained warm grade, natural highlights, and continuous slow pacing. Negatives: no people, boats, buildings, wildlife, text, logos, dialogue, music, wind noise, abrupt surf crashes, camera shake, cuts, zooms, time-lapse, or exaggerated saturation.
